verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs give an explicit, detailed captcha stance: automatic detection and solving via its vision model for reCAPTCHA v2/v3, hCaptcha, Cloudflare Turnstile, FunCaptcha, MTCaptcha, and text/image captchas, avoiding silent failure ambiguity. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that captcha solving works reliably in practice (community evidence discusses pricing, mobile UX, and credential handling but not captcha outcomes specifically), and no documented fallback/human-in-the-loop behavior specifically tied to captcha failures.
